question: Which diverse classes of beings are included among those associated with this teaching?
premises: Semi-divine and demonic beings are named
inference: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, asuras, and ascetics are all included.
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, asuras, and ascetics.
